title: GuestMessagingPermissionDocument
description: Server-maintained guest-owned read view of one WhatsApp permission row on the guest's messaging settings page: the guest's Catch row (id catchpref_{uid}) or one organizer row (an orgpref_ id derived from the organizer and the guest). preference is the sender's WhatsApp summary from the guest's users/{uid}/contactPermissions document, written in the same transaction as that document; released Catch builds read it until the guest minimum-build floor moves (issue #2460). Never an endpoint, consent copy or receipt contents, and never consent or dispatch authority; withdrawals still go through withdrawParticipantMessagingPermission, fenced on receiptId.
x-owner: Guest messaging permission projector (messaging guest messaging permission triggers)

organizerId.description: The sending organizer; null on the Catch row.
